hpwl_implementation: OpenROAD OpenDB legalized HPWL console output + validated extract_def_metrics
net_filter: All signal nets with >= 2 connected standard cell/macro pins (excluding global power/ground SPECIALNETS)
pin_coordinate_policy: Exact OpenDB pin center offsets in OpenROAD; standard cell origin in analytical python proxy
tolerance: 0.01% for bit-exact OpenROAD reruns; <= 0.10% for cell-origin analytical proxy
root_cause_explanation: In Phase 7 scratch/parameter_sweep.py, extract_def_metrics previously only parsed pin connections that appeared on lines following the net header. In OpenROAD write_def output, the first connection pairs appear immediately on the header line ('- net_name ( pin1 ) ( pin2 )'), causing 53,198 nets to be skipped and only 10,729 continuation-line nets to be summed (yielding 151,825.80 um). Fixing the regex parser to parse header-line connections immediately restores all 53,198 nets, yielding 731,824.32 um, exactly matching the physical design baseline within 0.09% of OpenROAD's pin-offset calculation (731,162.90 um).
